async_allocation_source: CudaContext::new queries MEMORY_POOLS_SUPPORTED; CudaStream::alloc selects result::malloc_async when true, synchronous fallback otherwise. Actual successful API incidence must be derived from frozen current-RAM trace, not inferred from source/hardware name.
mimalloc_lead_declined: Old eager_commit option is deprecated and only appears in option descriptors in locked default-v3 C source. Actual used arena_eager_commit is separate. Do not admit an ignored eager_commit environment setting as an optimization. No runtime allocator version or effective-option query made, and no native new setting tested. V3 is the build.rs default when V2 feature absent; future actual configuration would need native version/feature/effective-option proof.
closed_families: No D160 allocator replacement/VirtualAlloc, D126 prefetch, sparse-firsttouch, arenazero omission, E083fencebatching or E079context/planner overlap retry. No large/huge pages, privilege, power, OS, globalallocator or live-server setting change.
